metadata.short_desc: Multi-provider smart TTS plugin that auto-injects emotion tags and instruction control via a SubAgent.
metadata.desc: Multi-provider smart TTS plugin. Supports SubAgent auto-injection of emotion tags and instruction control, with a unified management page and KV-backed synthesis records.

enable_enhance.hint: When enabled, calls the LLM to auto-inject emotion tags and instruction control based on provider capability

enhance_llm_provider.hint: Model used to generate emotion tags and instructions; leave empty to use the current chat model

context_window.hint: Use the most recent conversation turns as the SubAgent's context reference

dual_output.hint: When enabled, TTS segments keep both text and voice messages

tts_prompt.hint: Inject prompt into the main model

synthesis_record_max.hint: 0 or a negative number disables synthesis-record persistence (no new records saved, but existing records can still be viewed/deleted); a positive integer keeps only the most recent N records, auto-deleting the oldest beyond that; 'unlimited' is not supported

page_background.hint: Set a background image for the TTS management page; leave empty to show none. Single image only. Keep it small (a few MB) — large images slow down page load.

page_background_opacity.hint: Background image opacity (0 = fully transparent, 1 = fully opaque)

memory_retrieval_top_k.hint: Works with LivingMemory. Requires the LivingMemory plugin to be installed, otherwise memory retrieval is disabled. Number of long-term memories returned; 0 = disable memory retrieval.

memory_retrieval_query_strategy.hint: user_message=use the text to synthesize as keyword; prefix=use a fixed prefix

memory_retrieval_prefix.hint: Only effective when the retrieval keyword source is set to prefix

providers.description: TTS provider list (multiple supported, falling back by priority)

display_name.hint: Display name of this provider config (to distinguish multiple providers of the same type)

persona_id.hint: Use this provider's voice only under the specified persona; leave empty to use it as a universal fallback voice

voice_id.hint: Voice ID (e.g. Kore/Zephyr/Puck); also accepts custom/design/clone voice_... IDs. Full library and voice design/clone: https://aistudio.google.com/generate-speech

timeout.hint: In seconds. Increase for longer texts.

proxy.hint: Proxy required to access the Google API (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890). Leave empty for direct connection.

display_name.hint: Used to distinguish multiple providers of the same type

persona_id.hint: Use only under this persona; leave empty for a universal fallback voice

model.hint: s2.1/s2 series; s2.1-pro-free is a free tier (no TTFA/DPA guarantee); use s2.1-pro for production

reference_id.hint: Voice Library model ID; leave empty for the default voice. Voice library: https://fish.audio/zh-CN/discovery, or create one at https://fish.audio/zh-CN/app/my-voices

mp3_bitrate.hint: In kbps, only effective for mp3

sample_rate.hint: In Hz, only effective for wav/pcm (8000/16000/24000/32000/44100); ignored for mp3/opus

opus_bitrate.hint: In bps, -1000 = auto, only effective for opus

normalize.hint: Rewrite numbers/dates into spoken words before synthesis (affects reading only, not accent); on by default

timeout.hint: In seconds; large texts may need a larger value

proxy.hint: Optional; may be needed for access from mainland China, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890

pronunciation_dictionary_version.hint: Must be given explicitly (no latest); regex ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$

repetition_penalty.hint: Must be >1.0; recommended to keep default

max_new_tokens.hint: Per-chunk audio token cap; recommended to keep default

condition_on_previous_chunks.hint: Keep voice consistent with previous audio; recommended to keep default

features.hint: Comma-separated, e.g. quality-guard; empty = default; recommended to keep default

elevenlabs_v4.hint: v4/v4 Turbo: write emotion into text [tags]
elevenlabs_v4.name: Eleven v4

display_name.hint: Used to distinguish multiple providers of the same type

persona_id.hint: Use only under this persona; leave empty for a universal fallback voice

voice_id.hint: Voice Library / cloned voice ID; library https://elevenlabs.io/app/voice-lab

language_code.hint: Eleven language code (free text; unsupported codes are silently ignored). Leave empty for the voice/platform default. The tool argument language_code can override per sentence. Common: zh, en, ja, ko, fr, yue, pt, es

proxy.hint: Optional; may be needed for access from mainland China, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890

timeout.hint: In seconds; large texts may need a larger value

use_voice_settings.hint: Override the voice's saved voice settings, effective for this request only; off = do not send (use voice default)

stability.hint: Higher = more stable/monotone; lower = more expressive; out of [0,1] is auto-clamped

similarity_boost.hint: Higher = closer to the reference voice, possibly at the cost of naturalness; out of [0,1] is auto-clamped

use_speaker_boost.hint: Improves similarity to the original speaker; increases latency

output_codec.hint: MP3 is universal; WAV is lossless; Opus is the most bandwidth-efficient

mp3_sample_rate.hint: At 22050/24000 the bitrate follows the sample rate (32k/48k) and cannot be changed; only 44100 lets you pick below

mp3_bitrate.hint: MP3 bitrate (kbps); 192k requires Creator tier or above

use_pronunciation_dictionary.hint: After enabling, replaces proper-noun pronunciation by dictionary; you must create the dictionary in Eleven first

pronunciation_dictionary_version.hint: Empty = latest; at most 3 placeholders per request

use_audio_effects.hint: When enabled, the AI attaches Eleven audio effects (phone/room/noise spatial texture). The plugin waits for the catalog to be ready before exposing effect params; if it times out, effects are skipped this time but preheating continues in the background for next synthesis.

catalog_fetch_timeout.hint: Network timeout (seconds) for fetching the audio-effects catalog, and the upper bound for waiting at synthesis time. On timeout, effects are skipped this time but preheating continues in the background.

catalog_ttl.hint: Cache duration (seconds) for the audio-effects catalog. Shorter = quicker to detect changes (e.g. new effects); longer = fewer repeated fetches

enable_logging.hint: Zero-retention can only be disabled on Enterprise; the standard tier forces it on

use_pvc_as_ivc.hint: Use the IVC version for professional voices; may improve expressiveness/lower latency; only effective for PVC voices
